notes.title: Deicider Demo - Patch 01
notes.content:
A glorious day to all arena fighters,
We just updated the Deicider demo with some bug fixes and changes, primarily:

Bug fixes:
- Fixed enemy entering arena behavior to prevent enemies from getting stuck in the spawn
- Fixed tutorial AI being able to get stuck on the elevator
- Fixed creator dropping arena rewards in inaccessible places
- Fixed blacksmith interaction not stopping movement
- Fixed the elevator never opening if you kill the tutorial AI before choosing an opponent
- Fixed [Play Again] button on end screen always spawning you with the same equipment
- Fixed health not saving between floors

Changes:
- Made fog of war slightly translucent when you discovered a room next to it
- Added option to switch between interactions using the scroll wheel or arrow keys

notes.title: Will we become the Deicider?
notes.content:
For 30 minutes each, the developers of Deicider will try to escape the Creator's Prison.

Deicider is a Dungeon crawling - Arena roguelike hybrid

We will showcase the demo for Deicider which you can download for yourself on the Deicider Steam page. 

If you've never seen the game, this is the perfect time to come and check out what a "Dungeon crawling - Arena roguelike hybrid" looks like

We'll see you in the chat, cheers
- The Deicider devs
